gloss_en: the air of the Land of Israel (avira de-Eretz Yisrael) — the Aramaic term for the holy atmosphere of the Land of Israel that makes one wise, identified in Likutey Moharan 37 with the sinless holy breath (hevel she-ein bo chet) of schoolchildren's Torah, through which the patriarchs are revealed and prophecy/ruach ha-kodesh is received
